nodes.summary: The decision problem SUDOKU accepts a bitstring $x$ exactly when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding of pairs of a natural number and a finite list of finite lists of natural numbers, to a Sudoku instance that is well formed and feasible. It rejects every bitstring that does not decode to an instance.
nodes.title: SUDOKU as a decision problem

nodes.summary: A Sudoku instance $(n, G)$, with block size $n$ and grid $G$ a list of rows of natural numbers, is feasible when there is a grid $C$ of natural numbers with exactly $n^2$ rows, each of exactly $n^2$ entries, such that, indexing rows and columns from $0$: for all $r, c < n^2$ the entry $G_{rc}$ is $0$ or equals $C_{rc}$, where an entry missing from $G$ counts as $0$; every row of $C$ and every column of $C$ lists…
nodes.title: Feasible Sudoku instances

nodes.summary: A Sudoku instance is a pair $(n, G)$ of a natural number $n$, the block size, and a grid $G$ given as a finite list of rows, each row a finite list of natural numbers; an entry $0$ stands for a blank cell.
nodes.title: Sudoku instances

nodes.summary: The decision problem SUDOKU lies in NP, and every decision problem in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to SUDOKU.
nodes.title: SUDOKU is NP-complete

nodes.summary: A Sudoku instance $(n, G)$, with block size $n$ and grid $G$ a list of rows of natural numbers, is well formed when $n > 0$, $G$ has exactly $n^2$ rows, every row of $G$ has exactly $n^2$ entries, and every entry of $G$ is at most $n^2$.
nodes.title: Well-formed Sudoku instances

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
